description.en: Wu Xiaodong (b. 1968, Shanghai) paints with mineral pigment on Xuan paper, letting water and gravity write every line. Carbon-Based Naturalism.
description.zh: 吴晓东(1968年生,现居上海),以矿物颜料在宣纸上作画,让水与重力写下每一条线。碳基自然主义。

caption.en: 2025 · Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper · 180 × 140 cm
caption.zh: 2025 · 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩 · 180 × 140 cm

bio.en: Wu Xiaodong was born in 1968 and lives and works in Shanghai. He studied at Nanjing University of the Arts and East China Normal University, and is guest professor at the Xu Beihong Art Academy and Shanghai Maritime University, and advisor to the China International Environmental Art Committee. He is the founder of Carbon-Based Naturalism. Working on Xuan paper with mineral pigment, he lets water carry colour under gravity and treats it as a co-author of the painting.
bio.zh: 吴晓东,1968年生,现工作生活于上海。先后就读于南京艺术学院与华东师范大学,现任徐悲鸿艺术学院、上海海事大学客座教授,中国国际环境艺术委员会顾问。他是「碳基自然主义」的创立者。他以宣纸与矿物颜料作画,让水在重力下带着颜色流动,并把水视为画作的共同作者。

text.en: Living things and water are made of the same cycle. Every living form is, in the end, a pattern that water has temporarily agreed to hold. Pigment seeping through the porous fibre of Xuan paper is treated as an organic process, slow, irreversible, and not fully reproducible by an algorithm.
text.zh: 生命与水出自同一个循环。每一种生命形态,说到底,都是水暂时答应保持的一种图案。矿物颜料在宣纸多孔纤维中的渗透,被视为一种有机过程:缓慢、不可逆,也无法被算法完全复现。

text.en: Neither the passive repetition of ink-brush habit, nor the frictionless production of algorithmic images. The third route lives in the tension between living matter and physical law: gravity, entropy, capillary seepage.
text.zh: 既不是笔墨惯性的被动重复,也不是算法图像的无摩擦生产。第三条路线存在于生命物质与物理法则之间的张力:重力、熵、毛细渗透。

text.en: Points are genetic matrices; lines are the vertical flux of falling water; planes are the bio-matrix of the paper itself.
text.zh: 点是基因式点阵;线是垂落之水的垂直流淌;面是纸张自身的生物基质。

caption.en: 53 seconds from the studio, with subtitles.
caption.zh: 来自工作室的 53 秒,含字幕。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: The rain was not drawn. Pigment and water are released from the upper edge and gravity writes every line. Behind the curtain stands a bamboo grove, one organism joined underground, and in the centre a pale clearing where the rain thins into light.
text.zh: 画中的雨并非画出,而是颜料与水从上沿释放,由重力写下每一条线。雨帘之后是一片竹林,地下相连、如同一个生命体;画面中央的留白,是雨渐薄成光的地方。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: A solitary pine and its stone meet vertical lines of white, diluted pigment released from the upper edge and surrendered to gravity. The lines pass through needle, stone and trunk without deviating.
text.zh: 一株孤松与岩石,迎面遇上垂直的白色线条:稀释的颜料从纸的上沿释放,交给重力。线条穿过松针、岩石与树干,毫不偏移。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: Wind enters the series. Diagonal lines sweep across dark rock before the painting clears into upright bamboo, dissolving into a pale, backlit distance.
text.zh: 风进入了这个系列。斜向的线条扫过深色岩石,画面随后转为挺立的竹,消融在苍白、逆光的远处。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: A garden seen through a curtain of falling water. First exhibited as Botanical Garden.
text.zh: 隔着一道落水的帘幕看见的植物园。此前展出时名为《植物园》。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: Banana leaves and perforated rock behind interwoven lines of rain: the leaf's way of telling you it heard the water.
text.zh: 芭蕉叶与多孔的岩石,隐在交织的雨线之后:这是叶子告诉你它听见了水的方式。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: Cool, silver-white. One young bamboo seen through a curtain of vertical lines, painted three times with only the colour temperature changed.
text.zh: 冷调,银白。同一株幼竹,隔着垂直线条的帘幕,画了三次,只改变色温。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: Warm, orange-red. One young bamboo seen through a curtain of vertical lines, painted three times with only the colour temperature changed.
text.zh: 暖调,橙红。同一株幼竹,隔着垂直线条的帘幕,画了三次,只改变色温。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: Green-gold. One young bamboo seen through a curtain of vertical lines, painted three times with only the colour temperature changed.
text.zh: 绿金。同一株幼竹,隔着垂直线条的帘幕,画了三次,只改变色温。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: A warm coral-orange glow through ochre and gold lines.
text.zh: 暖珊瑚橙的光,透过赭色与金色的线条。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: A pale, near-white disc, the moon or an opening in the rain itself, drawn with the same lines that make the rain.
text.zh: 一轮近乎白色的圆盘,是月亮,也是雨自身的一个缺口,由造雨的同一些线条画成。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: A small warm orange disc, a low sun, behind interwoven lines above dark rock and cooler banana leaves.
text.zh: 一轮小小的暖橙圆盘,如低垂的太阳,在交织的线条之后,下方是深色岩石与偏冷的芭蕉叶。

medium.en: Mineral pigment and watercolour on Xuan paper
medium.zh: 宣纸纸本、矿物质颜料、水彩

text.en: A luminous white disc dissolves leaves and rock into near-abstraction; only the dark, perforated stone stays clearly legible.
text.zh: 一轮发光的白色圆盘,把叶与石融成近乎抽象;只有深色、有孔的石头依然清晰。
